lastCompletedStory.title: Add merit-over-cost rule to subagent-implementer (both copies)

nextStoryContext: Added a new bullet to the '## Constraints' section of both .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md and templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md, framed for EXECUTION ('Always implement the most robust, root-cause fix for the story's acceptance criteria; never solve it with a workaround, gambiarra, or shortcut. A shortcut is legitimate only to unblock something extremely necessary in order to then solve the problem the correct way...'), carrying the dictated verbatim shared sentence identical (byte-for-byte) to US-001 (reviewer) and US-002 (auditor): 'This rule limits the quality of the recommendation, not its scope: Simplicity remains the scope limiter. Operational cost is never a criterion, but quality degradation from context-window exhaustion is a quality criterion, not a cost one.' Chose '## Constraints' as insertion point (NOT 'What you do for the story' step 2, which is the one section that differs byte-for-byte between the .claude/ and templates/ copies -- confirmed via diff before editing) because it is verbatim-identical text in both copies and is already a 'must'-style rules list, the closest implementer analog to the auditor's Section E item-19 insertion point. Both must-survive clauses preserved: clause 1 (limits QUALITY not SCOPE, so 'always most robust' doesn't license speculative abstraction) and clause 2 (operational cost never a criterion, but context-window exhaustion IS a quality criterion). Regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts via `bun run embed-vendor`; embed-vendor:check clean, full `bun run check:all` spine green (test 5256 pass/0 fail, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps all ok). No pattern-records.jsonl exists in this repo yet (checked, still absent), so appliedPatternIds is empty. Remaining PRD scope (if any): check prd.json for further stories in this merit-over-cost sweep (e.g. subagent-planner, /cam-plan-level docs) before assuming US-001/US-002/US-003 (reviewer + auditor + implementer) covers the full epic.
